description_en: Modifies the properties of a virtual border router (VBR) associated with an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 修改专线网关（ExpressConnectRouter）关联子实例(VBR)的属性
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter modify-express-connect-router-child-instance --ecr-id ecr-gny3gqp41n7vrrn5iz --child-instance-id vbr-t4n6xu2d5q0iaad1yl4le --child-instance-type VBR --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyExpressConnectRouterChildInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect Router instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual border router (VBR) instance
parameters.name: child_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the child instance. Valid value:

VBR: a VBR
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：
VBR：边界路由器实例
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the child instance. The description must be 0 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 子实例的描述信息。长度为0～128个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run to check the request without modifying any resources.

false (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. This token is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

You can generate a token from your client, but you must ensure that the token is unique across different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。


若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates that the call was successful. For information about other response codes, see the "Error codes" section
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为 200 表示成功，返回其他值表示失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the error message.

For example, if the error message is The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and this parameter returns DtsJobId, this means the DtsJobId parameter that you specified is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

True: The request was successful.

False: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败
